[EVENT] User redeemed 5,000 points to get $5 off a purchase of $25 or more at Walgreens.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for advice on how to maximize rewards earnings at Walgreens.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on redeeming points and getting a discount.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips to maximize rewards earnings at Walgreens, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Link your loyalty card to your Walgreens account.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Earn points on everyday purchases (10 points for every $1 spent).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Take advantage of bonus points offers on specific products.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use digital coupons to earn points on top of sale prices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Buy participating brands with the "Balance Rewards" logo.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Shop during point multiplier events for double or triple points.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Use the Walgreens app for exclusive deals and reminders.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Fill prescriptions at Walgreens to earn points.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Get points for participating in healthy choices programs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Redeem points strategically for higher-value rewards.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 11. Consider the Walgreens credit card for additional points.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 12. Regularly check points balance to avoid expiration.
